summary: New Oriental Education & Technology Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement that its board will meet on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 to approve unaudited results for the three months ended August 31, 2026. Results will be published before the U.S. market opens on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 via HKEXnews, with an earnings teleconference at 8 p.m. Hong Kong time the same day and an archived webcast. Signed by Executive President and CFO Stephen Zhihui Yang and Chairman Michael Minhong Yu. This is a routine earnings-scheduling notice, not a special situation.
